_about: Launch radar sources: official feeds and pages only for launches (no news sites, no rumours). Sources with category 'incident' are security news and vendor security blogs, used only to discover incidents (scoreIncident in lib.mjs); the writer cites primary sources and labels claims (site automation/RADAR.md). 'verified' = HTTP 200 with parseable items from an honest user agent on that date. Weight shifts every item's score for that source (high-volume or broad feeds get 0 or less). categoryBoost adds points per feed category; '(none)' applies when an item has no category.

sources.name: Microsoft 365 Message Center (community mirror mc.merill.net)
sources.note: Message Center is where retirements and changes are announced; pubDate is the last update. Low weight so routine rollouts stay below the threshold; M365 retirements due within 120 days clear it through the retirement floor in lib.mjs. Cite the MC number and confirm on Microsoft Learn.

sources.name: Tech Community: Windows IT Pro Blog
Reserve Bank of India press releases
The Hacker News
sources.note: Security news: discovery only. The writer cites the primary source (vendor or company statement, researcher post, exchange filing, advisory) and labels unverified claims.

sources.name: GitHub Blog: Security
sources.note: Official GitHub security posts and advisories (also feature posts; those are rejected unless they describe an incident or vulnerability with a user action).

sources.name: Microsoft Security Blog
sources.note: Official Microsoft threat intelligence and incident posts. Stands in for the MSRC blog, which has no working feed (see notUsed).

sources.name: ThePrint: Tech
sources.note: Indian tech and business news, for Indian bank, UPI, Aadhaar and consumer breaches. Discovery only: cite the company's exchange filing or statement first.

sources.name: MediaNama
sources.note: Indian tech policy news, for Indian consumer breaches and CERT-In or RBI actions. Discovery only (see theprint-tech).

notUsed.name: OpenAI Help Center release notes
notUsed.reason: HTTP 403 bot challenge for automated clients (2026-11-12). ChatGPT launches are covered through the OpenAI News RSS (category Product); the writer may still open help.openai.com pages while researching.

notUsed.name: Perplexity blog and changelog
notUsed.reason: HTTP 403 bot challenge for automated clients, no public RSS found (2026-11-12).

notUsed.name: Microsoft 365 Copilot Blog (Tech Community)
notUsed.reason: Feed returns no items (2026-11-12). Copilot launches come through the Microsoft 365 Blog, the Copilot blog and the roadmap.

notUsed.name: UIDAI (Aadhaar) press releases
notUsed.reason: No feed; the press-release page returns 404 and the home page is rendered by JavaScript (2026-11-12).

notUsed.name: NPCI press releases
notUsed.reason: JavaScript app shell with no items in the HTML (2026-11-12).

notUsed.name: DigiLocker
notUsed.reason: No news feed or dated announcements page (2026-11-12).

notUsed.name: CERT-In advisories and vulnerability notes
notUsed.reason: No RSS; the home page is a frameset and the advisory and vulnerability-note list pages return a script shell or 'Page Requested Currently Not available' to automated clients (2026-11-12). The writer may still open CERT-In pages while researching.

notUsed.name: Microsoft Security Response Center (MSRC) blog
notUsed.reason: The feed URL redirects to the HTML blog page (https://www.microsoft.com/en-us/msrc/blog), which renders its post list with JavaScript (2026-11-12). The Microsoft Security Blog feed (ms-security-blog) is used instead.

notUsed.name: MSRC Security Update Guide RSS
notUsed.reason: Works, but lists every CVE (about 5,700 items, 3 MB) with no exploited-in-the-wild flag, so it would flood the radar (2026-11-12).
